questions.p10: All eight answers preserve responsibility allocation, conduct and outcome readings, retain responsibility despite outsourcing, and require applicable standards and actual facts. UT 6.11C is valuation-specific and cannot automatically establish a general tokenisation supervision standard. No fulfillment, breach or original obligation closure is established; differences between arms remain descriptive.
questions.p14: All eight answers retain independent confirmation, request-conditioned demonstration and the competing footnote attachments, along with the separate audit and legal-opinion requests. Missing request records do not establish that no request occurred. No numeric high-confidence standard is invented. Equal Boolean trigger results do not establish equivalence of objects, standards or fulfillment. The preferred textual readings remain interpretive judgments, not authoritative resolutions.
questions.evidence: All eight answers distinguish activity from adequacy: completed reconciliation, matching records, allocated authority or supervised activity alone cannot establish substantive fulfillment. Ownership entitlements, evidence quality and coverage, discrepancy resolution and an applicable adequacy standard remain necessary. No actual Product Provider compliance or breach is established.
questions.gatecoin: The answers retain cryptocurrency's capacity for trust separately from actual ownership, the non-consenting-customer exception, evidence-sensitive consent, distinct relationships, the scenario-seven tension and missing transfer premises. Seven of eight nevertheless wrongly compare combined-packet hashes with individual DOCX hashes. The second retrieval answer avoids that allegation but fails five exact-source checks through altered quotations and unavailable source IDs, and remains rejected. Neither source identity nor solver agreement establishes precedential force or Product Provider fulfillment.

product_findings.baseline: Incomplete after 13 primary reservations. Twelve candidates were retained, six Boolean and six unformalized; five fidelity batches validated before a timeout, and criticism did not complete. The fidelity representation omits the candidate statement defining true as duty activation, inviting unsupported attributions of fulfillment. Later exact-question assignment restored that distinction, but an incompatible grant interface stopped execution. Six retained Boolean expressions passed subsequent offline XML preservation checks; no final dossier or graph was available.
product_findings.combined: Incomplete after eight primary reservations. Generation timeouts left no candidates, yet three subsequent question-assignment requests were issued and correctly rejected for invented placeholder candidate IDs. Eight live retrieval calls used task labels rather than the selected question; the adapter is now corrected. No live graph or XML check completed and no final dossier exists. The offline query correction showed no target-coverage gain on the small retained projection.
product_findings.scoped_diagnostic: After the grant interface repair, both arms completed two perspectives over the same two retained baseline claim/candidate pairs. All four responses preserved the explicit DUTY_TRIGGER question, separated source support from question relevance, and kept the footnote alternative and fulfillment uncertainty. The combined diagnostic used baseline records because its original generation failed. This verifies the narrow stage and authorization adapter, not completion of either primary investigation or retrieval superiority. Both internal call counts matched the two ledger reservations per arm.

source_scope_finding: Both additional responses passed exact-source checks and correctly distinguished the combined packet from individual DOCX files while retaining the legal qualifications. This supports the narrow typed-source-identity repair. The original seven false diagnoses remain in the primary comparison; the two later responses are post-observation diagnostics with no statistical ranking or legal closure.
review_scope: Agent substantive review of all retained direct and product responses, rejected responses, scoped diagnostic responses and source-identity responses against supplied records. Failed requests have no answer and remain explicit. No independent legal adjudication or complete current-law review.
